name: PREVIOUSLY IN GTM
tagline: A weekly read for founders, GTM leaders and growth marketers.
title: Write the renewal memo before the first deal is signed
standfirst: A long read on the one page document your buyer's champion will need in ninety days, and why the best operators this week were quietly drafting it on day one.
cover_sub: The one page document your buyer's champion will need in ninety days.

insight.label: By the numbers
insight.text: average wait for an inbound lead at monday.com in early 2025. Under two minutes once AI agents took the first call.
insight.source: Source: GTM Engineering newsletter (Alex Lindahl), reporting Oran Akron. Reported, not audited.

quote.label: Worth pinning above your desk
quote.text: You land in brand marketing and expand in growth marketing.

framework.title: Four lines of a renewal memo
framework.subtitle: Draft them before the first deal is signed.
framework.footer: Leave the numbers blank. Fill them in as you report.

items.name: Claim
items.question: What will the champion say out loud?
items.example: A sentence with a number in it, not a mood.

items.name: Baseline
items.question: What is the figure today?
items.example: Agreed in writing before anything changes.

items.name: Slice
items.question: Where can the claim fail cheaply?
items.example: One region, segment, placement or creator.

items.name: Schedule
items.question: When do you report unprompted?
items.example: Early, then again. Even when the number is dull.
